project: Atelier — August 6th updates — W2 CRUD completion
description:
Every dataset the CRM shows gains full create, read, update and delete — including the DELETE endpoints the API has never had, and a standalone Collections screen.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 2)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W1 merged into august-6th-updates in both repos
Blocks: W5 (reporting reads these models)

userStories.title: DELETE for brand and collection
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to remove a house or collection created in error, so that test rows do not accumulate forever.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a brand with products or collections returns 409 naming both counts
Deleting a collection with products returns 409 — the FK is SET NULL, so without the probe it would silently uncollect them
An unreferenced row is genuinely deleted and returns 200
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: DELETE for product and colourway
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to remove a product that was never sold, so that the catalogue reflects reality.
acceptanceCriteria: Order lines, samples and non-zero inventory each block with a named count
Colourways and zero-quantity inventory cascade as owned children
The order_lines RESTRICT edge is exercised by a test that proves the 23503 backstop produces the same 409 shape
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: DELETE for price-list item and contact enquiry
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to remove a bad rate row or a spam enquiry.
acceptanceCriteria: Neither has blockers
The price-list response or docs warn that npm run import:pricing recreates the row, so archive is the durable removal
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: DELETE for user with the self-delete guard
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want to remove an account that never transacted, so that a mistyped signup is not permanent.
acceptanceCriteria: Orders, trade applications and contact enquiries each block
Deleting yourself returns 403
trade_account_users is an access grant and cascades; it does not block
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Missing admin reads: brand, collection, price-list item by id
userStories.description: As the CRM, I want to re-read a single row after a write, so that server-generated fields appear without a full list refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/brands/:id returns the brand with its collections and counts
GET /admin/collections/:id returns the collection with brand name and product count
GET /admin/price-list-items/:id wires the already-exported getPriceListItem
Unknown id returns 404
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Colourway list and detail endpoints
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to browse colourways directly, so that I can find a SKU without opening its product.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/colourways is paginated — this is the largest catalogue table
Filters: product_id, brand_id, q, include_archived
GET /admin/colourways/:id exports the currently-private getAdminColourway
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Shipping-rate CRUD with the last-tier guard
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to manage freight tiers without a redeploy.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/shipping-rates wires the already-exported listShippingRates, with id added
POST returns 201; 409 on the (zone, threshold_qty) unique constraint
PATCH accepts rate_cents ONLY — zone and threshold_qty are the identity key
DELETE of the last tier for a zone returns 409, because an empty zone fails every checkout in it
The existing bulk PUT is unchanged and its tests still pass
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Inventory create and delete
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to restore an inventory row that was removed, so that a colourway can sell again.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /admin/inventory derives unit from the colourway product_type via UNIT_BY_PRODUCT_TYPE
unit is never accepted from the client
422 unknown colourway; 409 when a row already exists
DELETE is refused with 409 when qty_reserved > 0, because the release join would then match nothing forever
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Delete on the products and houses screens
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want a Delete action that explains itself when refused.
acceptanceCriteria: Both screens use useCrudScreen from W1; no bespoke dialog or pagination is added
A 409 keeps the dialog open and offers Archive instead
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: Standalone AdminCollections screen
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want collections managed on their own screen, so that they stop being buried inside houses.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /admin/collections, filterable by brand_id
COLLECTION_FIELDS moves out of AdminBrands with the panel
AdminBrands keeps houses only and links each row through to its collections
A collection slug is unique per brand, never globally — the screen must never assume otherwise
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: AdminShipping screen
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to edit freight tiers in the CRM, because nothing edits them today.
acceptanceCriteria: Create, edit rate, delete a tier
The last-tier 409 is surfaced as a readable refusal
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`

userStories.title: Delete on stock, supplier rates, orders and users screens
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want the same delete affordance everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: All four screens use useCrudScreen and the shared Pagination
The five copy-pasted paginators are gone — grep proves it
Orders offer archive only; there is no delete affordance for an order anywhere
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
